title: A beautiful castle with nice surprises to visit
text:
Visit to do if you go from Granada to Cordoba. 
Via the national highway, we quickly spot this castle perched on a hill.
There are very nice rooms to discover and the view from the towers is beautiful. Many parts are openly accessible and allow you to discover the bowels of this walled city. To do! Can be done with a stroller and children!
author: Ddmtpl34

title: An exemplary visit
text:
Fortaleza de la Mota is a perfect example of how history should be transmitted. The visit includes illustrations showing how the buildings looked originally, a 15-minute video about the history of the fortress and the town, 3D representations of some areas as they were in the 16th century, written information throughout the site, and a digital audio guide included in the ticket price. And it's a beautiful place!!
All this for just 8€, which also gives access to the Archaeology Museum in the town.
This is how history should be taught and experienced: complete, engaging, and interactive.

title: wonderful visit
text: It has been a wonderful experience and we are in the middle of a heatwave. It is a pleasure to be able to walk through what is now and thanks to the QRs see how it went. Everything looks great. All the audiovisuals are interesting but the church one is... super interesting and very emotional. What we've lost, for a change, to the wars. The number of burials and cisterns that can be seen. title: Much better than expected
text:
This was a stop on the route between Granada and Jaen, and the fortress was much better than expected.  

For one thing the views from the top over the surrounding countryside are great.  For another, the combination of 'restored' and 'under restoration' gave good insight into how archeological digs are done, and how restoration is done.  The tower and the church were fun to explore, especially the elevated walkways in the tower area (but you will need to climb a few steps to get full benefit of that).

The audio guide is exceptional, giving an excellent runthrough of the history for this comp
author: geo3

title: Monumental
text:
We had heard of the fortress, but we did not expect such a spectacular ensemble. 
We have visited other castles, but they were not as large or as well preserved.
You can see that they have made a great effort to restore and preserve this great monument. 
With the tickets comes a QR code, with which you can download an audio guide, quite complete. 
It is worth spending a morning visiting the fortress.
